title: Demo Envelope v1
$comment: Draft 2020-12 validates the closed envelope shape: the archived demo script binding, the granularity enum, the bounded auto_approved list, and the sandbox_dir string. Python validation additionally enforces the tier contract (full approves the whole script and declares nothing else; read-only-auto requires a non-empty auto_approved read-only command list and no sandbox_dir; sandbox requires a safe relative sandbox_dir), the demo/ archive path binding, and the lowercase SHA-256 script fingerprint. The envelope is advisory for commands the client permission system has already allowed; record_demo remains the enforcement point and routes unapproved commands to per-command approval (Codex permission fallback).
